title: Shared runtime protocol
responsibility: Defines request, response and runtime interfaces and constructs consistent transport failures.

inputs.name: runtimeFailure.code
inputs.description: Stable failure code to return unchanged.

inputs.name: runtimeFailure.message
inputs.description: Human-readable failure detail to return unchanged.

inputs.name: runtimeTimeout.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Timeout duration in milliseconds to name in the failure message.

outputs.name: runtimeFailure
outputs.description: Failure envelope with ok false and the supplied code/message.

outputs.name: runtimeTimeout
outputs.description: Failure envelope with code runtime-timeout and a message naming the timeout duration.
